about: Run settings the pre-registration freezes. status 'approved 2026-10-02' = Claude's recommendation, approved by the user (prereg/PREREGISTRATION.md section 0); 'design' = set by the user's original design. Nothing here is final until the pre-registration commit.

max_message_chars.why: C15: a 1,000-character message plus JSON can exceed a 256-token reply cap, more often at large scales

max_tokens.why: C15: room for a 500-character message at every scale; measured in Phase 7b

thinking.how: chat_template_kwargs {"enable_thinking": false} for both families; verified on the rendered prompt in Phase 7b

sampling.why: C1/C2 option (a): each family's published non-thinking values, except presence_penalty 0 (design)
sampling.amendment_2026_10_04: WP2d (prereg/AMENDMENT_WP2d.md): Mistral-Small-24B uses its card's T 0.15; phi-4 publishes no sampling recipe, so T 0.3 (low but non-zero, so a retry after an invalid reply can differ). top_p 1.0 / top_k -1 = off. Study 1/2 values unchanged.

seed.rule: E5: first 8 hex digits of SHA256('scale-invariance/call-seed/v1|<fixture>|<opener>|<msg_no>|<attempt>') as an integer; the same for all three scales

response_format.value: json_schema strict: action enum, price integer>=1 or null, message string maxLength = max_message_chars, additionalProperties false

messages_layout.value: one system message (prereg/prompts/system.txt) + one user message (user.txt, fragments.txt), rebuilt from scratch every call
